guideline: Fluency: Is the response fluent and grammatical? (1-5 scale)
Control-consistency: When control words appear in the response, are they appropriately used? (1-5 scale)
Relevance: Is the response a natural reply to the previous utterance in the conversation? (1-5 scale)
Coherence: Are all of the customer responses in the conversation coherent with respect to each other? (1-5 scale)
Diversity: Is there diversity in the customer responses of the conversation? (1-5 scale)
Two raters annotated each example, with fluency, control-consistency, and relevance rated per response, and coherence and diversity rated per conversation.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on constrained dialogue generation with lexical control words over multiple turns. The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization of dataset names (MultiWoZ), consolidation of model descriptions, and enhancement of human evaluation guidelines. The paper uses both automatic metrics (long-term success rate, precision/recall/F1) and human evaluation, but no LLM-as-judge evaluation.
